## Example 3.4 · (a) {#ss3-example-3-4-a .ap-lesson}

a\) Consider an arithmetic sequence with $a=2$ and $d=5$:

<div class="ap-subparts"><p><span class="ap-part-label">i)</span> Write out the first five terms and calculate the 20th term, <span data-math="a_{20}">a₂₀</span>.</p><p><span class="ap-part-label">ii)</span> State the linear function <span data-math="f(x)">f(x)</span> that generates this sequence for positive integer inputs <span data-math="n">n</span>. What is the gradient of this line?</p></div>

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 13 · Example 3.4(a)</p>

::: notes

\(i) 2,7,12,17,22; a_20=2+19(5)=97.
\(ii) a_n=2+5(n−1)=5n−3, so f(x)=5x−3 and gradient m=5. The next slide plots the first eight sequence terms and lets the class reveal the generating line. Note that f(0)=−3 whereas the first sequence term is f(1)=2.

:::
